MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SteelStik putty feels useful for small metal repairs, which connects naturally with my purchases of repair tape and vinyl cement.",
    "The washer assortment fits the same practical need as my clamp and wire connector kits: having several sizes available when a repair comes up."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Vacuum bags, a one-inch PEX valve, relay harnesses and refrigeration sealant require specific equipment or projects that I have not shown a need for.",
    "Super glue and thread seal tape are relevant to repairs, but 24 tubes or ten rolls would exceed what I currently need.",
    "The caliper interests me, but I would wait for a measurement task; I also lack a current reason to buy a temperature gun."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My clamp and connector purchases seem to have been taken as interest in any plumbing or automotive repair part, even when fit and purpose are very specific.",
    "My past purchases of supplies in quantity seem to have been extended to other bulk packs without considering how much of each product I would actually use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Broadly useful repair supplies appeal to me more readily than parts that require owning particular equipment or working on a particular system.",
    "Something can fit my repair interests without being a purchase I need now; tools and consumables still need a concrete use.",
    "An assortment gives me useful sizes to choose from, while many identical tubes or rolls may simply leave me with excess supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my practical repair interests, but assumed more specific projects and larger supply needs than my history supports."
}
